'''Willer Clines''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on [[Tazan]]. He supported the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and was the head of the [[Clines family]].
